title: Tapelog session event (v0)
description: One line of a tapelog session log: append-only, hash-chained JSONL. Canonical form and hash rules: docs/SCHEMA.md

payload.description: Type-specific data. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields.

policy_hash.description: session/start: hex SHA-256 of the policy file

id.description: JSON-RPC request id this event refers to (number or string)

args.description: tools/call: redacted arguments (object, or a blob reference {"$blob": {...}} — see session-log-v0.md §6.2)

is_error.description: tools/result: whether the tool returned an error

result.description: tools/result: redacted result (or error object, or a blob reference {"$blob": {...}} — see session-log-v0.md §6.2)

content.description: tools/result payloads may carry MCP content arrays

parent_seq.description: Optional causation link: seq of the event that caused this one (session-log-v0.md §6.1)

traceparent.description: Optional correlation: W3C traceparent copied from the request's _meta.traceparent (§6.1)

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the canonical form (docs/SCHEMA.md)
